gloss: bar district; drinking quarter; street of bars

definitions.gloss: bar district; drinking quarter; street of bars
definitions.explanation: An area or street concentrated with bars, izakaya, and other drinking establishments. A characteristic feature of Japanese urban nightlife.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶらぶら→ぶらぶら：05167_burabura⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To stroll around the bar district.
There is a bar district near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{帰|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{繰|く}り{出|だ}した→繰り出す：13882_kuridasu⟧。
examples.english: After work, I headed out to the bar district with my colleagues.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飲|の}み{屋|や}→飲み屋：17514_nomiya⟧ (bar, drinking establishment) and {街|がい} (district, quarter). Japanese cities typically have well-defined {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい} areas near train stations, often featuring narrow alleys lined with small bars and izakaya. Famous examples include ⟦{新宿|しんじゅく}→新宿：30634_shinjuku⟧ゴールデン{街|がい} and ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦{横丁|よこちょう}→横丁：18976_yokochou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out to the bar district
- {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink in the bar district
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}: the bar district in front of the station
- ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧レトロな{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}: a retro Showa-era bar district

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{繁華街|はんかがい}→繁華街：09392_hankagai⟧: entertainment district — a broader term that includes shops, restaurants, and other entertainment, not just drinking
- ⟦{歓楽街|かんらくがい}→歓楽街：09393_kanrakugai⟧: pleasure quarter — a nightlife and entertainment district, sometimes with adult-oriented establishments
- ⟦{横丁|よこちょう}→横丁：18976_yokochou⟧: side street, alley — a narrow lane, often lined with small bars and eateries
